expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) carries ONE row - 2-Jan-24, 'Self/Gary L Christensen', Filing Fee, $640.20 - whose date falls INSIDE this report's own stated period (2-Jan-24 to 11-Jun-24). The schedule's printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell is BLANK. On the cover, line 3 reads LAST 640.2, THIS 0, CUMULATIVE 0. The filer's own arithmetic does not close (640.2 + 0 is not 0), and a first report of a cycle should not carry a LAST-REPORT figure at all. The row sum 640.20 equals ONLY the LAST-REPORT cell, which is the previous report's total and is not a scope anchor for this filing's own ledger; it matches neither the THIS nor the CUMULATIVE cell. Published verbatim as a delta with needs_review 1 on the row. No figure was synthesised and no printed total was overwritten.

gates.balance_chain: Report 1 does NOT close (see recon_by_report). Reports 2 and 3 close. CROSS-FILING CHAIN RUN (three filings by one filer): report 2's CUMULATIVE column (contributions 640.20 / expenses 640.20 / balance 0) equals report 3's TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT column EXACTLY - that pair chains. Report 1's cumulative column (contributions 0 / expenses 0 / balance 640.2) does NOT equal report 2's LAST-REPORT column (640.20 / 640.20 / 0): from report 2 onward the filer carries his own 640.20 filing fee as BOTH a cumulative contribution and a cumulative expense, whereas report 1 records contributions as 0 and leaves its own expense cumulative at 0. The break is in report 1's cover, not between reports 2 and 3. Reported, not repaired - a human should look at this filer's 2024 covers.
